description: Stealth game with patrols, vision cones, occlusion, noise propagation, suspicion, hiding spots, keycard doors, alarms and extraction.

requirements.text: Guards transition from patrol to investigate/chase based on stimuli.
requirements.check: Guards transition from patrol to investigate/chase based on stimuli.

requirements.text: Unoccluded vision increases suspicion; occlusion blocks vision.
requirements.check: Unoccluded vision increases suspicion; occlusion blocks vision.

requirements.text: Noise attracts guards within hearing range but not outside it.
requirements.check: Noise attracts guards within hearing range but not outside it.

requirements.text: Valid hiding breaks ordinary visual detection.
requirements.check: Valid hiding breaks ordinary visual detection.

requirements.text: Only matching keycards open restricted doors.
requirements.check: Only matching keycards open restricted doors.

requirements.text: Alarm changes alert state and guard behavior.
requirements.check: Alarm changes alert state and guard behavior.

requirements.text: Extraction requires objective completion and no terminal failure.
requirements.check: Extraction requires objective completion and no terminal failure.
